design_philosophy.vibe: Apple meets Linear, but styled for a high-end luxury digital agency. A blend of ultra-clean precision and expensive, trustworthy aesthetics.
core_principles: Motion is deliberate: smooth momentum scrolling (Lenis) and line-by-line kinetic typography.
High-contrast hierarchy: massive headings, subtle borders, focused accents.
No generic blobs or gradients; use structural grids, crisp edges, and optical alignment.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large manifesto numbers.

motion.scroll: MUST use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling globally.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: masked line-by-line reveal for H1. Staggered fade up for subtitle and CTAs.
motion.hover_effects: Cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with an enhanced shadow and border color shift to gold-light. Buttons scale up slightly (scale-105).
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer Motion 'whileInView': opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0. Use viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.

buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0A0A0A] font-medium px-8 py-4 rounded-full border border-black/10 hover:border-[#D4AF37] transition-all duration-300

cards.default: bg-white border border-black/5 rounded-3xl p-8 md:p-10 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] transition-all duration-500

inputs.default: bg-[#FAFAFA] border border-black/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]/50 focus:border-[#D4AF37] transition-all

Header.layout: Fixed top, w-full, z-50. Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Border-b border-black/5.
Header.elements: Logo (Text 'Page Pilot' with blue plane/D+P mark accent), Nav Links (Hover text-gold), Book a Call button (Primary).

Hero.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden pt-20
Hero.elements: Kinetic H1 'AI That Works While You Sleep.', Subheading max-w-2xl text-center, Primary & Secondary CTAs. Visual: Subtle parallax abstract geometric/gold shape in background or floating elements.

Marquee.layout: w-full overflow-hidden py-12 border-y border-black/5 bg-[#FAFAFA]
Marquee.elements: Slow-moving editorial text (Cabinet Grotesk) separated by gold stars/dots.

Services.elements: 3 premium cards (AI Chatbots, AI Receptionists, Website Design). Each has a top icon (Lucide with gold accent), bold title, description. On hover, a subtle gold gradient wash at the card base.

Why_Choose_Us.elements: 8 minimal icon cards. White bg, soft borders. Very clean, focusing on trust and value.

How_It_Works.elements: Large numbers (e.g., '01', '02') in very light gray (text-black/5) acting as background. Step title in bold. Connector lines animating on scroll.

About_Manifesto.layout: Editorial layout, generous left padding, massive typography.
About_Manifesto.elements: Numbered manifesto format ('1. We Believe...', '2. The Standard...'). Spotlight effect on hover or real photography clipped into architectural arches/rectangles.

FAQ.elements: Shadcn Accordion customized to look expensive: no background, just 1px bottom borders, large typography, plus/minus icon animating in gold.

Contact_CTA.layout: Large rounded-3xl container bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white text-center py-24 relative overflow-hidden
Contact_CTA.elements: Headline 'Ready to Grow Your Business?', Gold Book a Call button. Subtle gold noise/glow in the background.

icons.styling: stroke-[1.5] text-[#0A0A0A] with subtle gold background circles or accents.

images.description: Abstract white and gold geometric shapes (Use as Hero background parallax element or About section visual)
Smiling female coffee shop owner (Use in Services or About section to represent local business client)
Minimalist white professional office desk (Use in Website Design service card or Contact section)

setup: Add the font imports to index.css and update tailwind.config.js to use 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Satoshi'.
Use Shadcn UI for standard accessible components (Accordion, Dialog for Contact Form), but strip away the default Vercel-look borders and apply the luxury styling.
execution: Implement the Lenis smooth scrolling wrapper at the root level.
Ensure the kinetic text reveal in the Hero uses actual Framer Motion line-by-line variants (split text into lines).
Do NOT use pure #000000 for text, use the specified #0A0A0A.
For the contact form, use a Dialog/Modal when clicking 'Book a Call' OR scroll to a dedicated contact section with a form.
Add `data-testid` to all buttons, form inputs, and accordion triggers.
universal_guidelines: Do not center align the app container. No generic blobs.
Use glass-morphism carefully: bg-white/70 with backdrop-blur-xl and a 1px border is mandatory for readable overlays.
Avoid universal transitions (no 'transition-all' without duration). Always specify what transitions, e.g., 'transition-colors duration-300'.
Ensure contrast ratios are met. Gold text on white background might fail APCA; use gold as an accent, background for buttons, or large thick text.
